Hi there! Welcome to LIET. What would you like to know?

Lendi Institute of Engineering and Technology (LIET) was founded in 2008. It is located at Vizag-Viziangaram Road, NH-43, Denkada, Jonnada, Andhra Pradesh 535005. The college is accredited by both NAAC and NBA. Contact: 089222 41666.
Lendi Institute of Engineering and Technology is located at: Vizag-Viziangaram Road, NH-43, Denkada, Jonnada, Andhra Pradesh 535005. Contact us at 089222 41666 for directions.
College working hours are 9:00 AM to 4:15 PM, Monday to Saturday. The college is closed on Sundays.
You can reach Lendi Institute of Engineering and Technology at: 📞 089222 41666. You can also email us at the department-specific email addresses.

LIET offers the following programs:

🎓 B.Tech (UG) Programs:
1. EEE - Electrical & Electronics Engineering (Intake: 120)
2. MECH - Mechanical Engineering (Intake: 120)
3. ECE - Electronics & Communication Engineering (Intake: 240)
4. CSE - Computer Science & Engineering (Intake: 360)
5. CSS - Computer Science & Systems Engineering (Intake: 60)
6. CIT - Computer Science & Information Technology (Intake: 60)
7. CSM - Computer Science & Engineering (AI & Machine Learning) (Intake: 60)
Duration: 4 Years (8 Semesters)

🎓 M.Tech (PG) Programs:
1. ES & VD - Embedded Systems and VLSI Design (Intake: 18)
2. CSE - Computer Science & Engineering (Intake: 09)
3. PS & CA - Power Systems & Control Automation (Intake: 18)
4. MD - Machine Design (Intake: 18)
Duration: 2 Years (4 Semesters)

Yes! M.Tech courses are available at LIET! 🎓

M.Tech (PG) Programs:
1. ES & VD - Embedded Systems and VLSI Design (Intake: 18)

For admissions contact: 089222 41666
The fee for all B.Tech (UG) programs at LIET is ₹62,300 per year. This applies to EEE, MECH, ECE, CSE, CSS, CIT, and CSM branches.
The fee for all M.Tech (PG) programs at LIET is ₹83,300 per year. This applies to ES&VD, CSE, PS&CA, and MD specializations.
LIET is accredited by both NAAC and NBA for most of its B.Tech programs. The M.Tech programs are accredited by NAAC. The college has been providing quality education since 2008.
